- **`_on_the_fly_rope_nodes`** — `Unsqueeze→Cast` (position ids) → optional `Cast→Expand→Where` (inv_freq) → `MatMul→Transpose→Concat→Cos/Sin→Mul(scaling)→Unsqueeze`, producing `rope_cos_out`/`rope_sin_out`.
- **`_rotate_half_nodes`** — dynamic `Shape→Gather→Div→Cast→Cast→Unsqueeze` slice index, two `Slice`s, `Neg`, `Concat`, two `Mul`s and a final `Add`.
- **`_rotate_half_initializers`** — the INT64 slice constants.
